reviewer: Codex - exported GLB renders and Babylon browser inspection

views.front: Connected moss upholstery, three distinct crowned seat cushions, attached welts and open oak slatted frame; no floating cushion or broken envelope visible.
views.rear: Rear support rails and continuous back remain legible; hidden zipper is intentionally concealed at normal viewing distance.
views.detail: Fine sewn line visible in browser close view, restrained cloth surface and board-aligned wood maps; no white sheen masking moss, ochre or blue tint.
views.underside: Crossed support webbing, support slats and recessed fasteners remain modeled and visible from below.
views.clay: Rounded cushion silhouettes, rails and repeated slats read without texture; no collapsed or filled openings seen.

limitations: This acceptance is for a single Beta sofa pilot, not a catalog-wide realism pass.
Tiny stitches and concealed zipper details are subtle at room distance.
The retained wood maps do not yet provide distinct end-grain ring textures.
10.64 MiB uncompressed GLB is within the pilot budget; room-scale loading on low-end mobile hardware was not benchmarked.
